title: ProofPulse: Interactive Proof Coverage Analysis for Dafny
abstract: arXiv:2608.30818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deductive verification ensures that an implementation satisfies its specification, but successful verification does not guarantee the quality of the specification. As such, weak specifications and redundant invariants may create overconfidence in ``verified'' code.   We present \proofpulse, a tool for Dafny that diagnoses specification quality using a three-valued proof coverage model. By analyzing proof dependencies, ProofPulse distinguishes between elements that contribute to specification intent, those used only for auxiliary checks, and those irrelevant to any proof obligation.   Evaluated against an oracle of 252 programs from the dafny-synthesis benchmark, ProofPulse provides a high-precision signal for specification weaknesses, particularly unnecessary preconditions and vacuous proofs. translated_title: ProofPulse：面向 Dafny 的交互式证明覆盖率分析
translated_abstract: 演绎验证确保实现满足其规范，但成功的验证并不能保证规范本身的质量。因此，弱规范和冗余不变式可能会让人们对“已验证”的代码产生过度自信。我们提出了 ProofPulse，一个用于 Dafny 的工具，它使用三值证明覆盖模型来诊断规范质量。通过分析证明依赖关系，ProofPulse 能够区分对规范意图有贡献的元素、仅用于辅助检查的元素，以及与任何证明义务无关的元素。在来自 dafny-synthesis 基准测试的 252 个程序构成的 oracle 上进行评估后，ProofPulse 为规范弱点提供了高精度信号，尤其是不必要的前置条件和空洞证明。通过 unsat-core 最小化，ProofPulse 在前置条件分类方面实现了完美精度，并减少了所有评估中的误报。
tldr: ProofPulse 是一个 Dafny 工具，通过三值证明覆盖模型分析证明依赖关系，能够高精度地诊断规范质量问题（如不必要的前置条件和空洞证明），并在 252 个基准程序上实现了前置条件分类的完美精度。
en_tdlr: ProofPulse is a Dafny tool that diagnoses specification quality using a three-valued proof coverage model, providing high-precision signals for weaknesses such as unnecessary preconditions and vacuous proofs, achieving perfect precision for precondition classification on 252 benchmark programs.
